scope.title: Comfort station structural steel (05 12 00; S2.1, S4.1, S4.2)
scope.text: Fabricate, hot-dip galvanize, shop prime and erect the comfort station steel: 3 moment frames on grids 1, 2 and 3 (6 W12x26 columns and 3 W12x26 beams with CJP beam-to-column connections), 1" base plates with (4) 3/4" F1554 Gr 36 anchor bolts per column (bolts supplied to GC for setting), and 12 HSS 5x3x1/4 roof purlins at 44" o.c. with shear tabs and clips. Field finish coats (HPC-1) by painter.

scope.title: Steel roof deck (05 31 00; 4/S4.1)
scope.text: Furnish and install approx. 1,000 SF of 1-1/2" Verco HSB-36, 20 ga, G60 galvanized roof deck with #10 self-drilling screws and button-punched seams, L3x3x3/16 reinforcement at roof-hatch openings, and continuous 1/4" bent-plate deck-edge support (approx. 128 LF).

scope.title: Steel bar grating screens (05 50 00; keynotes 5.5/5.6, 12/S4.2)
scope.text: Furnish and install approx. 700 SF of 19W4 galvanized steel bar grating screens (2'-0" x 8'-0" wall panels cut to roof slope and 2'-0" x 3'-8" counter panels) on continuous L 2-1/2x2x1/8 support angles with 1/4" clip plates and 1/2" A307 bolts, including cut-outs at meter and outlets.

scope.title: Site metals and furnishings (12 93 00; L1.00 rev. Add. 2)
scope.text: Furnish and install 6 Urban Accessories bike rails, 7 Tournesol PZ-075D-35 dome trash receptacles, 2 removable bollards with receivers, 1 dog waste station, and 2 Bison PR87 freestanding basketball systems with 36" dia x 4' footings; plant protection fence (9/L3.23) with 2" raw steel end posts, 4" wood stakes at 4'-0" max and 1/4" stainless wire rope.

scope.title: Park signage (allowance; L1.00, L3.25–L3.26)
scope.text: Pierce County Parks standard signs S1 (1), S2 (3), S3 (1) and S5 (4), pre-engineered by sign manufacturer, furnished and installed through S&S as an allowance based on the design team's estimated on-site costs; adjusted to the sign manufacturer's quote.

scope.title: Submittals and compliance
scope.text: Stamped structural shop drawings and erection plan, deck and grating product data, galvanizing certification, furnishing product data and color samples, L&I Intents/Affidavits, certified payroll and apprenticeship-hour reporting to the prime contractor.

exclusions: Bid Alternate No. 1 Picnic Shelter steel (priced separately on request), Alternates 2–5 (skate spot, Roly Poly, site irrigation/trees, right-of-way gates and bollards).
Benches (11), picnic tables (PT, PT2, PT3), boulders and bronze castings, logs and log steppers, trail counter, play equipment, synthetic turf and surfacing.
Light-gauge cold-formed framing (05 40 00), sheet-metal awning/gutter and edge flashing (keynotes 5.4/5.7), roof hatch, doors and hardware, field finish painting (09 90 00/09 96 00).
Concrete footings, grade beams and slabs for the comfort station (anchor bolts supplied only), special inspection and testing (Owner), survey and layout control, permits.
Performance & payment bond (add 1.5% if required), Washington retail sales tax (collected by prime per WAC 458-20-171).

Signage carried as a $52,610 allowance; if the design-team figures for S2 and S5 are per sign rather than per type, add approx. $45,000. Basketball count (2), dog waste stations (1), plant protection fence (≈110 LF, 2 runs) and grating area (≈700 SF) scaled from drawings — confirm before award.
assumptions: Comfort station steel quantities scaled from S2.1 (1/4"=1'-0"): 34'-0" x 22'-0" grid, columns ≈10.5' avg; W12x26 assumed for columns and beams per roof framing plan labels.
Steel roof deck installed by S&S per 05 31 00; deck-edge cantilever design by deck supplier (included).
